name: SISO Declassified Records
summary: A research department for declassified government records, separating record truth, custody and release truth, source-asserted truth, and research conclusion, with four rights-and-safety tiers.

relationships.context: Split out of the Great Library on 2026-08-07. Working research material with an executable verifier does not belong inside a metadata catalog.

evidence.summary: Split executed 2026-08-07. The Great Library README states it is a catalog rather than a giant monorepo, and ADR-0005 rejected storing the People Graph database on the same grounds; working research material with executable code belongs in its own Work rather than inside the catalog.

Four safety tiers are defined (standard, enhanced_privacy, hazardous_technical, restricted_metadata_only) with the governing principles that a capability manual must not be assembled from individually public records, that official release does not eliminate risk, and that a name in an intelligence or law-enforcement file is not proof of guilt, affiliation, reliability or agency employment. The last of these directly constrains any future People Graph link built from this material.

The department holds that FOIA release and declassification are not synonyms, separating formal declassification, FOIA, mandatory declassification review, systematic review, statutory special collections and never-classified archival-open material, and rules that the system must never silently move from source-asserted truth to research conclusion.

Executed against the split repository after the filter: PASS at module_files=13, sources=37, official_sources=32, collections=30, schema_required_fields=17, relative_links_checked=22. This verifies internal structural consistency only; no document payload was acquired and no source claim was adjudicated.

The repository and exact commit resolve on GitHub at main@fb615f281b6c89c31a5c16b3512299f2e1064569 with 3 commits of history carried across from branch agent/declassified-government-records-department of sisodias/great-library-of-siso using git filter-repo path selection, not a fresh initialisation. This verifies addressability and that commit lineage survived the split; it does not assert a release, packaged artifact, or deployment, none of which exist for this Work.

license.reason: No license has been selected. Underlying records are predominantly US Government work in the public domain, but per-item rights are not guaranteed and the department's own policy records custody and release state rather than assuming it.

evidence.summary: No LICENSE file is present in the split repository and no license has been selected for the SISO-authored material. Recorded as pending rather than asserting a permissive default.
